slots.na_reason: No external integration exists in v1 by decision, not by omission: the credit score (FR-03) is a deterministic in-process stub and the funding source (FR-08) is a recorded identifier. The Out of Scope deny-list forbids real credit-bureau calls, payment rails and live provider credentials, so there is no external trust boundary for a requirement to constrain. Revisit when a real bureau or disbursement rail is attached.

No retention window is specified by decision: every identifier the system holds is synthetic test data, no real PAN or Aadhaar is ever stored, and KYC/AML verification against external registries is on the deny-list. NFR-03 already bars identifiers and salary-document content from logs, and documents are metadata-only with no binary content retained. A retention period becomes a real requirement the moment production data is in scope.

Covered by requirement rather than by a dedicated NFR: FR-14 requires the end-of-day recalculation to be idempotent and as-of-date parameterised, so a failed run is recoverable by re-running it, and NFR-07 gives the startup liveness signal. Partial-batch failure semantics beyond re-runnability were considered and deliberately not specified for v1, and R-2 records the append-only versus correction tension design must resolve.
